validationFailures.name: save_brief
validationFailures.signature: validation:REQUIRED_INFORMATION_REQUEST:Required question is untracked. Call request_information with needId "deployment-config" and question "What deployment configuration changed in deployment 42?" before saving. An empty missing list cannot satisfy this requirement.

checkpoint.task: Prepare an engineering handoff about checkout errors after deployment 42. Cover both the health log and deployment configuration. If deployment configuration is unavailable, request it from a collaborator and save a pending brief with the missing information. When supplied, update the brief using the new source. Distinguish observed timing from uncertain root cause.

usage.scope: Sum of exposed per-call SDK counters, including reload after peer restart. No model worker memory measurement.

stateAudit.scope: Read only peer A after shutdown. The other peer directory was not read.

limits: One default short-record native attempt on this source, not a reliability rate or a long-record/selector comparison.
Existing runtime, installed dependencies, worker bundle and cached weights reused; fresh peer stores. No fresh install or uncached download.
Quotations and state checks do not prove source truth or causal correctness.
New owner-answer and partial-cleanup failures have controlled regressions; this ordinary native handoff does not inject those faults.

processCleanup.scope: Checked after the demo and persisted-state audit both exited. Existing stores were retained.
